main.description: An album published to an AT Protocol personal data server. Groups songs under a named release by a specific artist.

did.description: The AT Protocol DID of the account that owns this album record.

artist.description: AT URI of the artist record associated with this album (local.open-music-streaming.artist).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this record was created, in ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 format.
